name: Gradiant 5G Charts
what_it_is: A collection of Helm charts for deploying 5G network functions and simulators on Kubernetes, maintained by Gradiant for its Lab5G platform. It packages Open5GS, Free5GC, UERANSIM, srsRAN 5G, PacketRusher, and OAI gNB as individually-tunable charts consumable from DockerHub OCI registry.
components: open5gs (5G SA core: AMF, AUSF, BSF, NRF, NSSF, PCF, SCP, SEPP, SMF, UDM, UDR, UPF, WebUI)
open5gs EPC components (HSS, MME, PCRF, SGWC, SGWU) for 4G/LTE
free5gc (5G SA core: AMF, AUSF, CHF, NRF, NSSF, PCF, SMF, UDM, UDR, UPF, WebUI)
ueransim-ues (UERANSIM UE simulator, scalable replica count)
srsran-5g (srsRAN Project gNB, app v23.10.1, real RF via UHD/USRP)
srsran-5g-zmq (srsRAN Project gNB with ZMQ virtual RF transport)
srsran-4g / srsran-4g-zmq (srsRAN eNodeB + UE for LTE, app v22.04.1)
packetrusher (HPE PacketRusher multi-UE 5G load tester, commit 2b26573)
MongoDB (bitnami/mongodb ~18.0.5, shared datastore for Open5GS and Free5GC)
protocols: LTE / 4G (via srsRAN 4G and Open5GS EPC charts)
NAS (Non-Access Stratum, UE registration and session management)
NGAP (N2 control plane, AMF–gNB, port 9487 for PacketRusher)
ZMQ (virtual RF transport for software-only RAN simulation)
measurement: PacketRusher exposes optional Prometheus metrics endpoint (metrics.enabled toggle + ServiceMonitor and VictoriaMetrics ServiceScrape CRD support)
srsran-5g ships a sidecar monitor image (image.monitor) for metrics scraping
Kubernetes liveness and readiness probes on srsran-5g (livenessProbe, readinessProbe) provide health signals
Open5GS WebUI (port 9999) provides subscriber and session visibility
Free5GC WebUI provides equivalent subscriber management UI
configuration: MCC/MNC defaults to 999/70 across all charts; overridable per chart via Helm values
TAC defaults to 0x0001; slice SST defaults to 1 with SD 0x111111
AMF hostname wired via amf.hostname (e.g. open5gs-amf-ngap) for RAN-to-core connectivity
srsran-5g RF: device_driver (uhd or zmq), device_args, srate (23.04 MHz), dl_arfcn, band, channel_bandwidth_MHz, common_scs (30 kHz), tx_gain, rx_gain
srsran-5g-zmq uses ZMQ TCP sockets (tx_port tcp://127.0.0.1:2000, rx_port tcp://127.0.0.1:2001)
Open5GS subscriber provisioning via populate.initCommands using open5gs-dbctl (add, add_ue_with_apn, add_ue_with_slice subcommands)
UERANSIM UE auth credentials: key (Ki), op/opc, opType (OPC/OP), initialMSISDN; UE count controlled by ues.count
PacketRusher UE identity: msin, key, opc, dnn; gNB identity: gnbid, mcc, mnc, tac, sst, sd
OAI gNB supports Ettus USRP hardware via resources.limits.ettus.com/usrp Kubernetes device plugin
MongoDB auth disabled by default (mongodb.auth.enabled: false); shared URI via dbURI template
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection mechanisms are provided by the charts
Privileged containers with NET_ADMIN capability (srsran-5g, packetrusher) allow manual tc/iptables-based network impairment inside pods
modes: 5G SA (Standalone) core + RAN: Open5GS or Free5GC + UERANSIM gNB/UE or srsran-5g or PacketRusher
4G/LTE EPC mode: Open5GS EPC (HSS, MME, PCRF, SGWC, SGWU) + srsran-4g or oai-enb
Software-only simulation (ZMQ): srsran-5g-zmq gNB paired with srsran UE over virtual RF sockets, no hardware required
Real RF hardware mode: srsran-5g with USRP B200 (UHD driver), oai-gnb with Ettus USRP device plugin
Multi-UE load testing: PacketRusher multi-UE mode (args: ["multi-ue"]) or UERANSIM with ues.count > 1
constraints: Kubernetes-only deployment: all charts require a running Kubernetes cluster; no Docker Compose is provided
Linting and install testing require Docker and kubernetes-in-docker (kind); not runnable on bare metal without a K8s cluster
srsran-5g and packetrusher require privileged pod security context and NET_ADMIN capability; clusters with restricted PSP/PSA will block deployment
OAI gNB requires the Ettus USRP Kubernetes device plugin for hardware RF; unavailable in software-only environments
Open5GS and Free5GC depend on MongoDB (bitnami/mongodb ~18.0.5); MongoDB auth is disabled by default, unsuitable for production
Charts are published as OCI artifacts on DockerHub (registry-1.docker.io/gradiant); Helm OCI support (helm 3.8+) is required
No built-in inter-chart service mesh or encryption between NFs; SBI communication is plain HTTP/2
srsran-5g startup probe has a 600-second initial delay, making automated readiness checks slow in CI pipelines
notable_absences: No Docker Compose files; the project is Helm/Kubernetes-only
No 5G core for standalone Free5GC UPF testing (UPF chart exists but no free5gc-upf standalone RAN pairing tutorial)
No built-in observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana) — metrics scraping requires separately deploying kube-prometheus-stack
No packet capture or PCAP tooling included in charts
No roaming or inter-PLMN simulation support (SEPP chart exists in Open5GS but no tutorial covers it)
srsran-5g README is absent from the repo (Chart.yaml and values.yaml exist but README.md is missing)
